item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
This page is a complete mess. I assume the aim was to list the SCPs in reverse chronological order, but that just produces a list that looks completely random and is unpleasant to interact with. I genuinely can't fathom whatever scheme was used for the Tales, they seem arranged completely randomly

The basic information (SCPs, tales, etc.), is ill-formatted and thrown all over the page with absolutely no regard for utility. SCPs should be listed sequentially by page number like they are on any tag listing so that readers can intuitively find what link they're looking for, and should preferably have their mainlist name listed here so that each entry is more recognizable. The tales should be formatted by series where possible - it's ridiculous that a series with 20+ entries(Cool War) has all its entries strewn randomly among unrelated tales, with the first entry being at the bottom of the page, and no indication whatsoever that they are related.

I can't see any reason for the state these lists are in, because they make this page incredibly difficult for actually navigating to AWCY? content, which is the ultimate long-term purpose of the page.

item.title: Staff Post: Addition - Attribution Notice.
item.content:encoded:
Yes, and it is done, with permission from Zyn and working with Smapti.

As stated in the article, SCP-173 is a secondary use of the image of the art piece "Untitled 2004", which was created by Izumi Kato. The concept of SCP-173 does not have any relationship with the artist's original concept of "Untitled 2004".

Images of the "Untitled 2004" sculpture may be used for non-commercial purposes only.
